title: 16S rRNA gene sequencing of urban airborne microbiota in Changsha, China
description: This project investigates the composition and spatiotemporal variation of urban airborne microbial communities in Changsha, China. Airborne microbial samples were collected monthly from three urban functional zones, including commercial, industrial, and recreational areas, over a one-year period. The microbial communities were characterized using 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing to investigate the seasonal and spatial dynamics of airborne microbiota.
